errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the first four lines are solid blue lines, and the last two are green, which is a key organizational feature of the chart.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie mit Sternen (1) repräsentiert städtische Regionen mit Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern und verläuft zwischen etwa 25 % und 33 %, mit einem Maximum von 33 % um 1985
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a peak for line 1 at 33% around 1985. The peak in that period is around 31% in 1988.
The description for line 2 states it begins at 15% in 1984, but the chart shows it starts at approximately 16.5%.

errors.text_span: fällt auf 10 % um 1995, steigt dann wieder auf 17 % um 2005
errors.evidence: The description for line 2 incorrectly describes its trend. The line does not fall to 10% around 1995 (it dips to ~12% around 1996), and its peak is closer to 18% around 2006, not 17% in 2005.
In the description of line 3, it is stated that the line peaks at 14% around 2000. The chart shows the peak is approximately 15% around the year 2001.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie mit Quadraten (4) für städtische Regionen mit Mehrfamilienhäusern in zentralen Lagen beginnt bei 15 % im Jahr 1984, fällt auf 10 % um 1995, steigt dann auf 17 % um 2005 und schwankt danach um 15 %.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the trend for line 4 is incorrect and appears to be a repetition of the (also incorrect) description for line 2. Line 4 actually starts at ~17.5%, peaks at ~20% in 1990, and ends around 17%.

errors.text_span: fällt auf 20 % um 1990, steigt dann auf 25 % um 2000
errors.evidence: In the description of line 5, it incorrectly states a dip to 20% in 1990 (the line is at ~22% then) and a peak of 25% in 2000 (the peak is ~26.5% around 2003).
The description for line 6 states it begins at 15% in 1984, but the chart clearly shows the starting value is approximately 12%.
In the description of line 6, the year of the dip is stated as 2005, but it occurs around 2007 in the chart.

errors.text_span: wobei die städtischen Regionen mit Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern (Linie 1) die höchsten Anteile aufweisen, während die ländlichen Regionen mit Mehrfamilienhäusern (Linie 6) die niedrigsten Werte zeigen.
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly forbids making comparisons between lines. This sentence directly compares line 1 and line 6, stating which has the highest and lowest values.
The prompt instructed to write a single paragraph, but the output is split into two paragraphs.

errors.text_span: Die grüne Linie mit einer durchgezogenen Linie (6)
errors.evidence: The phrase "Die grüne Linie mit einer durchgezogenen Linie" (The green line with a solid line) is redundant and awkwardly phrased. "Die grüne durchgezogene Linie" (The solid green line) would be more natural.
